text: DEFONEOS — MOD Submarine Delivery Agency AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × SUBMARINE DELIVERY AGENCY MOD Submarine Delivery Agency AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of the UK Submarine Delivery Agency — Dreadnought programme delivery, AUKUS nuclear submarine collaboration, nuclear safety assurance, and sovereign supply chain intelligence. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Programme Dreadnought Programme AI Dreadnought-class SSBN programme oversight — four-boat build schedule (Boats 1–4). Barrow-in-Furness construction milestone tracking. BAE Systems submarine delivery contract management. Programme cost monitoring against £31bn+ budget envelope. Nuclear propulsion system integration governance. Astute-class parallel build coordination. Vanguard-to-Dreadnought transition planning. Continuous At-Sea Deterrent (CASD) handover risk management. AUKUS AUKUS Integration AI AUKUS Pillar I nuclear-powered submarine collaboration — SSN-AUKUS design and build pathway. UK–Australia technology transfer governance under bilateral treaty. US Virginia-class technology transfer under ITAR. Australian submarine construction yard readiness assessment. Joint work force training programme (Pine Gap, Barrow, Adelaide). Common combat system integration. Propulsion technology sharing protocols. Export control and classification management across three nations. Safety Nuclear Safety Governance AI ONR (Office for Nuclear Regulation) licence condition compliance. Nuclear safety case management for Dreadnought-class reactor systems. Defence Nuclear Safety Regulator (DNSR) oversight. Radiation exposure monitoring and ALARA compliance. Submarine reactor refuelling and defuelling protocols. Nuclear waste management and disposal (Sellafield pathway). Emergency response and nuclear accident scenario modelling. INLA (Independent Nuclear Safety Assessment) lifecycle governance. Supply Chain Supply Chain Sovereignty AI UK sovereign submarine component sourcing — critical raw materials (HMS Sheffield steel, reactor-grade materials). Tier 1–4 supplier mapping across SDA supply chain. BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce, Babcock prime contractor governance. Single-source supplier risk identification and mitigation. Sovereign capability preservation for nuclear submarine systems. Foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI) screening. Export control (ITAR/EAR) compliance across supply chain. Just-in-time logistics for Barrow shipyard operations. Workforce Workforce Skills Pipeline AI Submarine build workforce skills pipeline — 10,000+ skilled trades at peak. Nuclear-qualified welder, pipe-fitter, and electrician training. SDA graduate and apprentice intake management (800+/yr). Security-cleared workforce planning and development. NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) certification tracking. Defence nuclear skills retention programme. Cross-shipyard workforce mobility (Barrow, Devonport, Faslane, Rosyth). Diversity and inclusion in nuclear submarine workforce. Digital Digital Shipyard AI Barrow-in-Furness digital shipyard transformation — Building Information Modelling (BIM) for submarine construction. Digital twin of Dreadnought-class hull and systems. 3D design-to-manufacture integration. Automated welding and inspection robotics. Real-time construction progress monitoring. Supply chain digital thread from design through commissioning. Cyber-physical system integration on the production line. Shipyard layout optimisation using simulation. Through-Life Through-Life Support AI Submarine through-life cost optimisation — 30+ year operational lifespan management. Planned maintenance periods (PMPs) at Devonport and Faslane.
